paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the Spearman’s R correlation of models *M* as a function of the number of models, displayed on a logarithmic scale. The x-axis, labeled “Number of models *M* (log)”, ranges from 25 to 500, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 25 and values displayed in base-10 logarithmic units. The y-axis, labeled “Spearman’s R correlation of models *M* (log)”, extends from approximately 0.90 to 0.98, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.02 and values also presented on a logarithmic scale. A single blue line represents the Spearman’s R correlation, which begins at approximately 0.98 at x = 25 and decreases gradually to a value of approximately 0.96 at x = 500; the value at x = 25 is reported as 0.98, while at x = 500 it is reported as 0.96.
